scope: Public manufacturer feature families only. All dimensions, layouts, tooling shells and motions are authored studies, not supplier replicas or production process definitions.

sources.title: Protolabs: stocked punch form tooling
sources.used: Public examples of louver, bridge lance, dimple/emboss and rib features; an upper punch and lower die are described. No catalog dimensions or CAD are copied.

sources.title: Mate: forming applications
sources.used: Feature families include round embosses, round extrusions, dimples, card guides and curved beads. These inform the crossmember and annular-cover study families; dimensions are authored.

sources.title: Mate: bridge and cable-clamp forming applications
sources.used: Single-bridge cable clamps and double-bridge card guides establish the two-ended lance family. The cable panel is an original combination of bridges, dimples and edge flanges.

sources.title: Mate: strengthening ribs
sources.used: Public rib-forming examples motivate the corrugated shield family. No strength increase is quantified or established by the geometry study.

sources.title: Beckwood: deep drawing
sources.used: The manufacturer distinguishes forming motion, blank holding and material flow, and discusses multiple draws for demanding parts. The stepped housing is a target geometry; its sequence is illustrative and unqualified.
